title: NNTP OVER range: invalid input silently becomes Range(0,0) instead of 501
description: reader/session/command.rs:254,258,262: parse_range() uses unwrap_or(0) on parse failures. OVER abc-def is parsed as Range(0, 0) and processed as a valid range rather than returning 501 (Syntax error). RFC 3977 §8.3.2 requires 501 for malformed range syntax. Fix: return Err on parse failure; dispatch sends 501.
